title: Olavina Aasare
desc: Jayant, a criminal, is hired by a crime boss to marry a wealthy estate owner's daughter, Rajini, and take over her property. However, in a twist of fate, things go awry.

title: Navashakti Vaibhava
desc: A couple make vows in the name of the Almighty for the betterment of their children. When they grow up and become successful, the couple forget to fulfil their vows, causing their children to suffer.

title: Seetharama Kalyana
desc: Arya is an altruistic individual who constantly sacrifices his happiness for his loved ones. Consequently, his romance with innocent Geetha faces severe hurdles.

title: Natasaarvabhowma
desc: An investigative journalist, Gagan, moves to Bengaluru and ends up living in a supposedly haunted house. Soon, he realises a change in his behaviour after falling prey to supernatural activities.

title: Milana
desc: Anjali's father forces her to marry Akash. Unable to forget her past, she demands a divorce from Akash, but soon begins to fall for him.

title: Krishna Leele
desc: Krishna is deeply in love with a woman and yearns for her at any cost. However, chaos ensues when another man falls in love with her.
